# 1.
```{r}
set.seed(123)
x <- rnorm(50)
B <- 1000
n <- length(x)
theta.hat <- median(x)
x.grand <- matrix(sample(x, B * n, replace = TRUE), nrow = B)
theta.grand <- mean(apply(x.grand, 1, median))
```

```{r}
# bias
bias <- theta.grand - median(x)
```

```{r}
# standard error
se <- sqrt(sum((apply(x.grand, 1, median)-theta.grand)^2)/(B-1))
se
```

```{r}
# standard normal bootstrap CI
theta.hat - bias + c(-qnorm(0.975), qnorm(0.975)) * se
```

```{r}
# basic bootstrap CI
theta.b <- apply(x.grand, 1, median)
2 * theta.hat - quantile(theta.b, c(0.975, 0.025))
```

```{r}
# bootstrap t-interval at 95%
se.b <- function(x) {
  n <- length(x)
  x.grand <- matrix(sample(x, B * n, replace = TRUE), nrow = B)
  theta.b <- apply(x.grand, 1, median)
  theta.grand <- mean(theta.b)
  return(sqrt(sum((theta.b - theta.grand)^2) / (B - 1)))
}
t.b <- (theta.b - theta.hat) / apply(x.grand, 1, se.b)
t.star <- sort(t.b)
theta.hat - quantile(t.star, c(0.975, 0.025)) * se
```

# 2
```{r}
cvm.test <- function(x, y, B = 1000) {
  n <- length(x)
  m <- length(y)
  
  Fn.x <- ecdf(x)
  Gm.y <- ecdf(y)
  
  W2 <- (m*n)/(m+n)^2*(sum((Fn.x(x)-Gm.y(x))^2)+sum((Fn.x(y)-Gm.y(y))^2))
  
  z <- c(x, y)
  
  stat.p <- rep(0, B)
  
  for (i in 1:B) {
    z.p <- sample(z, n + m)
    x.p <- z.p[1:n]
    y.p <- z.p[(n + 1):(n + m)]
    
    Fn.xp <- ecdf(x.p)
    Gm.yp <- ecdf(y.p)

    stat.p[i] <- (m*n)/(m+n)^2*(sum((Fn.xp(x.p)-Gm.yp(x.p))^2)+sum((Fn.xp(y.p)-Gm.yp(y.p))^2))
  }
  
  p.value <- (sum(stat.p >= W2) + 1)/(B + 1)
  
  return(list(
    statistic = W2,
    p.value = p.value
  ))
}
```

# 3
```{r}
spearman.permtest <- function(x, y, B = 1000) {
  r <- cor(x, y, method = "spearman")
  r.p <- rep(0, B)
  
  for (i in 1:B) {
    y.p <- sample(y, length(y))
    r.p[i] <- cor(x, y.p, method = "spearman")
  }
  
  p.value <- (sum(abs(r.p) >= abs(r)) + 1) / (B + 1)
  
  return(list(
    rho = r,
    p.value = p.value
  ))
}
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
x <- rnorm(50)
y <- 0.2 * x + rnorm(50)

spearman.permtest(x, y)
```

```{r}
cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman")
```
